_doc: 立绘模板（A4 固化，2026-08-14）。多图分工参考图 + 风格签名 + No-Beautify，见 SKILL_gpt-image-2.md 5.3

splash.style_signature: Arknights official art style (Wei@W style signature): thin clean elegant lineart, soft painterly cel-shading with gentle gradients, low-saturation muted warm-gray palette (#B8AD9E #6E6558 #F5F0E8), delicate fabric and armor detail rendering, soft diffuse lighting, gentle highlight roll-off, subtle film-like finish, semi-realistic proportions, no heavy outline, no CG plastic skin.
splash.multi_ref_role: Image 1 is the art-style anchor: learn ONLY its lineart, coloring, shading, painterly texture and finish quality. Image 2 is an additional same-style detail reference; use it only for style details.

views.portrait: full body, standing pose, facing viewer
views.bust: head-and-shoulders chest-up portrait closeup, facing viewer, same character design
views.side_view: same character, full body, side view profile facing left, exact same outfit hair colors and design as the front view, consistent design
views.back_view: same character, full body, back view seen from behind, exact same outfit hair colors and design as the front view, consistent design

splash.output_constraint: natural skin texture, visible pores, no text, no watermark. AR 3:4
splash.no_beautify: Do NOT copy the reference character's face, pose, or outfit. Match the line weight, coloring/shading technique, level of detail and finish exactly. Style consistency first; do not invent a new style. Do not replace the face with a generalized, beautified, or idealized face.
